title: Oklahoma methods, WMA rules, and restrictions

methods.label: Archery
methods.summary: Archery deer season is typically statewide with WMA-specific closures or antlerless rules.

methods.label: Muzzleloader
methods.summary: Primitive firearms deer season dates follow the current ODWC regs.

methods.label: Gun / rifle
methods.summary: Deer gun season is typically late November; some areas are controlled hunts only.

methods.label: Shotgun
methods.summary: Turkey, dove, quail, and waterfowl; non-toxic shot for waterfowl.

prohibited: Hunting a controlled hunt without the drawn permit.
Hunting in refuge or closed portions of a WMA.
Violating area-specific firearm or vehicle restrictions posted for that WMA.
unitRules: Each WMA may have special regulations that differ from the statewide season.
Some Corps lakes are open under ODWC seasons; others host controlled hunts.
Preference points apply only to controlled-hunt applications.
